requirements.summary: Diagnose and resolve deployment failure - Frontend aspects
acceptanceCriteria: The application successfully deploys to the Internet Computer network
The deployment completes without throwing errors

file_operations.description: Review and verify actor initialization code handles canister ID resolution correctly post-deployment. Ensure the actor creation logic properly references the deployed backend canister and handles any network-specific configuration. Check that error handling during actor initialization is comprehensive and logs meaningful diagnostic information.

Verify that the application entry point correctly initializes all required providers (React Query, Internet Identity) and that there are no configuration issues preventing successful deployment. Ensure environment-specific settings are properly configured for network deployment.

requirements.summary: Validate frontend imports and actor integration reference deployed backend correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend successfully connects to the backend actor after deployment
All API calls from hooks properly resolve to backend methods
No console errors related to actor initialization or canister communication

file_operations.description: Verify that all type definitions in the backend interface match the actual Candid interface exported by the deployed backend canister. Ensure that all method signatures, parameter types, and return types are correctly defined. Check that ExternalBlob types from blob-storage component are properly integrated where video and photo file fields are used.

Verify that the video upload hook correctly converts Files to ExternalBlob using the blob-storage component and that the uploadVideo backend method call passes the correct ExternalBlob representation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure error handling captures any type mismatches or serialization issues during upload.

Verify that the photo upload hook correctly converts Files to ExternalBlob using the blob-storage component and that the uploadPhoto backend method call passes the correct ExternalBlob representation. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure error handling captures any type mismatches or serialization issues during upload.

Verify that the video fetch hook correctly handles ExternalBlob data returned from the backend. Ensure that the Video type's file field is properly deserialized and can be used with the blob-storage component's getDirectURL() or getBytes() methods for display. Add error handling for any data format inconsistencies.

Verify that the photo fetch hook correctly handles ExternalBlob data returned from the backend. Ensure that the Photo type's file field is properly deserialized and can be used with the blob-storage component's getDirectURL() or getBytes() methods for display. Add error handling for any data format inconsistencies.

Verify that the video player page correctly uses ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() to render video content from the blob-storage component. Ensure the video element properly handles the direct URL for streaming and that any errors during blob URL resolution are caught and displayed to the user.

Verify that the photo viewer page correctly uses ExternalBlob.getDirectURL() to render photo content from the blob-storage component. Ensure the image element properly handles the direct URL and that any errors during blob URL resolution are caught and displayed to the user.

Verify that video card thumbnail rendering correctly handles ExternalBlob data if thumbnails are derived from video files. Ensure proper fallback to the generated video placeholder image at frontend/public/assets/generated/video-placeholder.dim_320x180.png when video data is unavailable or still loading.

Verify that photo card thumbnail rendering correctly handles ExternalBlob data. Ensure proper fallback to the generated photo placeholder image at frontend/public/assets/generated/photo-placeholder.dim_320x320.png when photo data is unavailable or still loading.

Review the video listing logic to ensure it properly handles the two-step fetch (metadata then full data) and that ExternalBlob deserialization works correctly for all videos. Verify error handling for partial failures and ensure the hook gracefully handles cases where some videos fail to load.

Review the photo listing logic to ensure it properly handles the two-step fetch (metadata then full data) and that ExternalBlob deserialization works correctly for all photos. Verify error handling for partial failures and ensure the hook gracefully handles cases where some photos fail to load.
